edges.reason: initDone guard prevents re-initialization in init().
admin state variable gates setPendingAdmin via msg.sender check.
msg.sender must equal admin before setting a pending admin.
pendingAdmin is read and compared in acceptAdmin.
msg.sender must equal pendingAdmin to accept the admin role.
superAdmin state variable gates setPendingSuperAdmin.
msg.sender must equal superAdmin before setting a pending super admin.
pendingSuperAdmin is read and compared in acceptSuperAdmin.
msg.sender must equal pendingSuperAdmin to accept the role.
init writes the sbEthFeePool reference.
init writes the sbController reference.
init writes the token reference.
init sets the initial admin address.
init sets the initial super admin address.
init flips initDone to true.
msg.sender supplies tokens and owns the mine accounting entries in mine().
amount parameter drives fee computation and accounting in mine().
mining fee numerator/denominator read from sbController in mine().
token is used to pull funds in mine().
sbEthFeePool receives the mining fee in mine().
mine() performs an external ERC20 transferFrom before accounting completes.
mine() forwards ETH to an external fee pool contract.
mine() updates the caller's mine day array.
mine() updates the global mine day array.
current day for mining is derived from block.timestamp.
mine() calls _update to rewrite the mine accounting arrays.
msg.sender receives unmined tokens in unmine().
amount parameter drives fee computation and accounting in unmine().
unmining fee numerator/denominator read from sbController in unmine().
unmine() forwards ETH to an external fee pool contract.
unmine() transfers tokens to msg.sender, an external call reachable by a malicious token.
current day for unmining is derived from block.timestamp.
unmine() calls _update to rewrite the mine accounting arrays.
claimAll reads the caller's mine arrays and claimed day.
claimAll reads minerDayLastClaimedFor to bound the claim window.
vesting days are read from sbController in claimAll.
claimAll day boundary depends on block.timestamp.
claimAll delegates the actual claim to _claim().
claimUpTo reads the caller's mine arrays and claimed day.
day parameter determines the claim target day in claimUpTo.
claimUpTo reads minerDayLastClaimedFor to bound the claim window.
vesting days are read from sbController in claimUpTo.
claimUpTo validates the target day against block.timestamp.
claimUpTo delegates the actual claim to _claim().
getRewardsDueAll computes outstanding rewards via _getRewardsDue.
getRewardsDueUpTo computes outstanding rewards via _getRewardsDue.
_getCurrentDay derives the day directly from block.timestamp.
_update uses block.timestamp modulo for seconds since start of day.
_update mutates mine day arrays through storage references.
_update mutates global mine arrays through storage references.
_claim obtains the reward amount from _getRewardsDue.
claiming fee numerator/denominator read from sbController in _claim.
_claim sends the ETH fee to the external fee pool.
_claim calls the external controller to request rewards before finishing state writes.
_claim writes minerDayLastClaimedFor after requesting rewards.
upToDay parameter bounds the rewards loop in _claim.
miner parameter selects whose rewards are computed in _claim.
vestingDays parameter offsets the claimable window in _claim.
attacker-controlled msg.sender is the recipient of the external token transfer.
msg.sender is used as the source address of the token transferFrom.
miner address passed to the controller originates from caller context.
per-day pool rewards are read from sbController in _getRewardsDue.
_getRewardsDue queries per-miner seconds via _getMinerMineData.
_getRewardsDue queries pool seconds via _getMineData.
_getMinerMineData loads the miner day array.
_getMinerMineData delegates the lookup to _get.
_getMineData loads the global day array.
_getMineData delegates the lookup to _get.
_get calls _find for in-range day lookups.
reward accrual iteration window depends on current day derived from block.timestamp.

normalization_plan.reason: amount parameter only feeds the mine() fee computation and accounting update.
amount parameter only feeds the unmine() fee computation and accounting update.
miner parameter is only used to select and record claim data inside _claim().
upToDay parameter only bounds the rewards loop and stored claimed day in _claim().
dayLastClaimedFor parameter only seeds the rewards loop lower bound in _claim().
vestingDays parameter only offsets the claimable window in _claim().
rewards local variable is computed and consumed entirely within _claim().
currentDay local variable is derived from block.timestamp and consumed by the accounting update.
fee local variable is computed from controller rates and required msg.value inside mine().
day parameter only sets the claim target day validated and used in claimUpTo().
